title: alexandrov-topology
description: The topology on a poset whose open sets are exactly the up-sets (sets closed under going up along the order), making finite topological spaces equivalent to finite posets and bridging combinatorial poset theory with topological sheaf theory.

poset.description: the partially ordered set (P, <=) on which the topology is built

opens.description: the collection of open sets of the topology, drawn from the subsets of P

open-sets-are-up-sets.description: U is open iff U is an up-set: x in U and x <= y implies y in U (dually, down-sets; the choice fixes a direction)

monotone-equals-continuous.description: monotone maps of posets correspond exactly to continuous maps of the Alexandrov spaces; sheaves on (P,<=)_Alex are functors P -> V
